main_text.head: AMVLETVM.
main_text.p:
EN syntagma datum, indubio magis inclyta vero Gruningea dein quo foret historia:
Ars nulla hic mythici, κολακείαve Macrobiani,
Cum sua sint rebus fila sacrata suis.
Nil clandestina quod libertate petulce:
Nil vage quod rodas hic Holerin[?]Lepus:
Lactucas labris aliunde requirire vellis;
Mente tamen memori quo fugiatis ea.

In laudem historiæ solidumq; autoris honorem,
In fremitum at vobis, en epigrammation:
Mordeat vt Momus, vt liveat Invidus, amplo est
VBBO fide Livio plus mihi, parq; stylo.

page.notes: Ornamental headpiece above AMVLETVM not transcribed. The right edge of the scan cuts off the ends of lines ("honorem", "est", "amplo"); the words are as far as they are visible. "Holerin" is followed by a mark that may be a reference symbol, not a letter [?]. "vellis" is partly covered by a dot in the scan [?]. "libertate" and "fugiatis ea" are uncertain in the scan. Errata line "p. ead. l. 24. aele comma" is doubtful [?]. The Greek word "κολακείαve" is hard to read [?]. "VBBO" is printed in capitals and may be a typeset form [?]. Printing errors are left as printed.
